## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md has a line under Unreleased for anything apps will see
- [ ] No secrets, keys or personal data in the code, commits or screenshots
- [ ] Docs and `.env.example` updated if setup changed
- [ ] Screenshots for anything people see (light and dark, phone and desktop)
- [ ] Works with a keyboard and a screen reader, with readable contrast
